title: Resting-state fMRI biomarkers of surgical outcome in temporal lobe epilepsy: Network reorganization, rsfMRI-based prediction models, and cognition - a systematic review
title_zh: 颞叶癫痫手术预后的静息状态fMRI生物标志物：网络重组、基于rsfMRI的预测模型与认知——系统综述
abstract: Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is a network disorder extending beyond the structurally defined epileptogenic zone. Resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI) may provide information on brain network alterations relevant to seizure outcome and cognitive risk after epilepsy surgery. We reviewed rsfMRI studies in TLE surgical cohorts to evaluate postoperative network changes, preoperative predictors of seizure outcome, and associations between functional connectivity and cognition. This systematic review followed PRISMA guidelines and was registered in PROSPERO. Fifteen studies were included, comprising 474 TLE patients who underwent resective epilepsy surgery and had at least 1 year of follow-up. Studies were reviewed for patient population, surgery, rsfMRI methodology, networks or regions, outcome definition, postoperative network changes, and cognitive assessments. Despite heterogeneity in patient selection, surgery, rsfMRI analysis, and outcome definition, studies consistently reported reduced DMN-related connectivity in TLE compared with healthy controls. Postoperative functional connectivity in seizure-free patients shifted toward healthy control patterns in few studies. Preoperative rsfMRI-based prediction models showed promising accuracy for predicting seizure outcome but were generally developed in small cohorts and lacked external validation. Evidence relating rsfMRI to cognition was limited, but implicated thalamic and ascending reticular activating system connectivity in visuospatial attention. RsfMRI is a promising research biomarker for network-level risk stratification in TLE surgery, particularly for seizure outcome prediction and postoperative network reorganization. Current evidence remains insufficient for clinical implementation. Future studies require larger homogeneous multicenter cohorts, standardized acquisition and preprocessing, consistent outcome definitions, systematic postoperative rsfMRI, neuropsychological assessment, and external validation of prediction models.
abstract_zh: 颞叶癫痫（TLE）是超出结构性定义癫痫发病区的网络疾病。静息状态功能磁共振（rsfMRI）可能提供有关癫痫手术后癫痫结果和认知风险相关的大脑网络改变的信息。我们综述了TLE手术队列中的rsfMRI研究，以评估术后网络改变、术前癫痫结果预测因子以及功能连接与认知之间的关联。本系统综述遵循PRISMA指南，并在PROSPERO注册。共纳入15项研究，包括474例接受癫痫切除术的TLE患者，且随访至少1年。研究回顾了患者人群、手术方式、rsfMRI方法、网络或区域、结果定义、术后网络改变以及认知评估。尽管患者选择、手术方式、rsfMRI分析和结果定义存在异质性，但各项研究一致报告了TLE患者与健康对照组相比，默认模式网络（DMN）相关连接减少。术后少数研究报道了无发作患者的功能连接向健康对照组模式转变。术前rsfMRI基于预测模型显示在预测癫痫结果方面具有前景，但通常在小样本队列中开发，且缺乏外部验证。关于rsfMRI与认知的证据有限，但暗示丘脑和上丘网状激活系统在视空间注意中的作用。rsfMRI是TLE手术中网络层面风险分层的有前景的研究生物标志物，特别是用于癫痫结果预测和术后网络重组。目前证据不足以用于临床实施。未来的研究需要更大的同质化多中心队列、标准化的采集和预处理、一致的结果定义、系统的术后rsfMRI、神经心理学评估以及预测模型的外部验证。
